title: DynaTokens: Teaching Dynamics to Camera-Controlled Video Models at Test Time
title_zh: DynaTokens: 教授相机控制视频模型在测试时动态

paragraphs.en: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer’s camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成必须考虑两种运动来源：一种由观察者的相机路径引起，另一种由场景动态造成。 理想的相机控制视频模型应当同时考虑这两种运动：让用户移动相机的同时推动场景动态演化。 虽然当前模型在静态场景中能很好地处理相机引起的运动，但它们在动态场景中表现不佳：物体保持静止、运动方式错误，或生成质量下降。 我们提出 DynaTokens，这是一组轻量级、可学习的场景特定 token，用于向现有的相机控制世界模型传授动态知识。 我们的方法源于两种运动来源之间的一个简单不对称性：相机运动全局性地影响生成的画面，而物体动态在空间上是局部的。 通过交叉注意力，DynaTokens 仅用某个场景的少量示例轨迹即可训练可学习 token，同时保持基础模型冻结，并能在新的查询相机路径下实现动态效果。 在 VBench2 和 WorldScore 评测上，DynaTokens 相比 LoRA、块级微调以及专用可训练层等基线方法，取得了更好的动态与相机同时兼顾的权衡。 对 token 注意力的分析、消融实验以及运动时间性的研究表明，让可训练接口与学习目标的结构相匹配，对于有效适配十分重要。 项目网站：https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/

paragraphs.en: Current camera-controlled video models [ 23 , 25 , 2 , 22 , 30 , 10 ] can generate navigable “worlds” from a image or text prompts, opening new possibilities for gaming, immersive media, and robotics. However, despite their ability to follow camera trajectories, these models struggle with dynamics [ 31 , 18 ] : the generated worlds often looks static, generate incorrect motion, or degrade in visual quality when the scene should evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的相机控制视频模型 [ 23 , 25 , 2 , 22 , 30 , 10 ] 可以从图像或文本提示生成可导航的“世界”，为游戏、沉浸式媒体和机器人技术开辟了新的可能性。 然而，尽管这些模型能够遵循相机轨迹，它们在动态性方面仍存在困难 [ 31 , 18 ] ：生成的世界往往看起来是静态的，会产生错误的运动，或者在场景本应演化时视觉质量下降。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has shown that test-time training can adapt video foundation models to support new capabilities, including long-horizon generation [ 7 ] , scientific discovery [ 32 ] , and reasoning [ 1 ] . However, enabling scene dynamics in camera-controlled video models remains challenging because current architectures inject camera information directly into the generative flow process – via PRoPE [ 15 ] , Plücker ray embeddings [ 33 ] , or action conditioning [ 23 , 10 ] – entangling camera control with dynamics generation. As a result, supervision on dynamics can inadvertently degrade camera control, and naive fine-tuning methods such as LoRA [ 11 ] perform poorly. This observation motivates a new approach to model adaptation. We introduce DynaTokens, a test-time training method that selectively teaches scene dynamics while preserving the camera-control behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作表明，测试时训练可以使视频基础模型适配以支持新能力，包括长时程生成 [ 7 ]、科学发现 [ 32 ] 和推理 [ 1 ]。 然而，在相机控制的视频模型中实现场景动态仍然具有挑战性，因为当前架构通过 PRoPE [ 15 ]、Plücker 光线嵌入 [ 33 ] 或动作条件化 [ 23 , 10 ] 将相机信息直接注入生成流过程，使相机控制与动态生成纠缠在一起。 因此，对动态的监督可能会无意中损害相机控制，而诸如 LoRA [ 11 ] 之类的朴素微调方法表现不佳。 这一观察促使我们探索一种新的模型适配方法。 我们提出 DynaTokens，这是一种测试时训练方法，能够在选择性学习场景动态的同时保留相机控制行为。

paragraphs.en: DynaTokens builds on a simple principle: in video generation, camera control is global, influencing every patch across every frame, whereas scene dynamics can be spatially local, often confined to the objects that move or change. To exploit this distinction, DynaTokens introduces learnable tokens that steer the video latents toward localized dynamics without altering the global scene generation. By decoupling local dynamic control from global camera control, this design enables dynamic scene generation while preserving camera controllability.
paragraphs.zh: DynaTokens 建立在一个简单的原理之上：在视频生成中，相机控制是全局的，会影响每一帧中的所有图块，而场景动态可能在空间上是局部的，通常仅限于发生移动或变化的物体。 为了利用这一区别，DynaTokens 引入了可学习的 token，将视频潜变量引导至局部动态，而不改变全局场景的生成。 通过将局部动态控制与全局相机控制解耦，这一设计能够在保持相机可控性的同时实现动态场景生成。

paragraphs.en: DynaTokens is lightweight: a few scene-specific tokens are added and learned while keeping the base model frozen. It can be trained from only a few samples ( ≈ 15 \approx 15 ) and generalize to unseen camera trajectories, producing videos under novel camera controls. Importantly, these few training trajectories need not be high quality: they can be short, contain background artifacts or motion discontinuity. Through test-time training of the tokens, DynaTokens can overcome these limitations, generating temporally continuous videos with prompt-aligned dynamics for new trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: DynaTokens 是轻量级的：只需添加并学习少量场景特定的 token，同时保持基础模型冻结。 它可以仅从少量样本（≈ 15）训练，并能泛化到未见过的相机轨迹，在新颖的相机控制下生成视频。 重要的是，这些少量训练轨迹不必高质量：它们可以是短片段，或包含背景伪影和运动不连续。 通过对 token 进行测试时训练，DynaTokens 可以克服这些局限，为新轨迹生成时间上连续且动态与提示对齐的视频。

paragraphs.en: We show quantitatively and qualitatively that DynaTokens effectively enables dynamics without compromising camera control, surpassing current capabilities of state-of-the-art camera-controlled world models on VBench2 [ 35 ] dynamic-related categories and WorldScore [ 8 ] . Baseline methods such as LoRA, block finetuning, or Test-Time Training layers struggle. Beyond dynamic motion categories, we show that DynaTokens can also enable physics and stylistic changes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 VBench2 [ 35 ] 动态相关类别和 WorldScore [ 8 ] 上定量且定性地证明，DynaTokens 能有效实现动态效果而不损害相机控制能力，超越了当前最先进相机控制世界模型的能力。 LoRA、块微调或测试时训练（Test-Time Training）层等基线方法均难以胜任。 除动态运动类别外，我们还证明 DynaTokens 也能实现物理特性和风格的变化。

paragraphs.en: We provide analysis on the DynaTokens design to understand the disentangling of dynamics with camera control. We also probe the temporality aspects of dynamic tokens to better understand how they elicit dynamic behavior of base models. Our analyses on test-time training of dynamic tokens provide deeper insight into architecture and representation of world models, paving the way for future development of large-scale world models. We also illuminate how to effectively adapt these models at test time to enable new capabilities. Additionally, DynaTokens offers a path toward video data generation. Existing efforts in collecting dynamic, camera-annotated data rely on synthetic environments, such as games [ 6 ] . DynaTokens, via efficient test-time training, opens up generation of camera-controlled videos in diverse settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 DynaTokens 的设计进行了分析，以理解动态与相机控制的解耦。 我们还探究了动态 token 的时间性方面，以更好地理解它们如何引发基础模型的动态行为。 我们对动态 token 测试时训练的分析为世界模型的架构与表示提供了更深入的洞察，为未来大规模世界模型的发展铺平了道路。 我们还阐明了如何在测试时有效适配这些模型，以实现新的能力。 此外，DynaTokens 提供了一条通往视频数据生成的路径。 现有的收集带相机标注的动态数据的工作依赖于合成环境，例如游戏 [6]。 DynaTokens 通过高效的测试时训练，开启了在多样场景下生成相机控制视频的可能性。

paragraphs.en: We develop DynaTokens, which significantly improves dynamic scene generation for camera-controlled video models via test-time training, evaluated on VBench2 and WorldScore.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DynaTokens，它通过测试时训练显著改进了相机控制视频模型的动态场景生成，并在 VBench2 和 WorldScore 上进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: DynaTokens is a new architecture design which decouples dynamics from camera control, enables much better performance than alternatives like LoRA and TTT layers.
paragraphs.zh: DynaTokens 是一种新的架构设计，它将动态效果与相机控制解耦，能够实现远优于 LoRA 和 TTT 层等替代方案的性能。

paragraphs.en: We identify a structural mismatch between existing adaptation methods and the underlying transformations they model: LoRA-type methods apply global parameter updates, whereas object dynamics is spatially localized. We provide analysis on how DynaTokens overcomes this limitation via a design that aligns with the learning target.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现现有适配方法与其所建模的底层变换之间存在结构性不匹配：LoRA 类方法采用全局参数更新，而物体动态是空间上局部的。 我们分析了 DynaTokens 如何通过与学习目标相一致的设计来克服这一局限性。

paragraphs.en: Camera-controlled video models are flow-based video generation models that take in camera control, along with image and text, as conditioning signals. Camera conditioning can be achieved in 4 ways: noise warping [ 4 , 22 ] which warps the noise based on camera movement, PRoPE [ 23 , 31 ] which encodes camera frustum in positional embedding, action conditioning [ 23 , 10 ] which encodes discrete camera actions, and plücker ray embedding [ 25 , 22 ] , usually channel-wise concatenated. We design DynaTokens to minimally affect camera conditioning and selectively “teach” dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 相机可控视频模型是一类基于流的视频生成模型，它将相机控制与图像、文本一同作为条件信号输入。 相机条件化可以通过4种方式实现：噪声扭曲[ 4 , 22 ]，即根据相机运动对噪声进行扭曲；PRoPE [ 23 , 31 ]，即在位置编码中编码相机视锥；动作条件化[ 23 , 10 ]，即编码离散的相机动作；以及plücker光线嵌入[ 25 , 22 ]，通常按通道拼接。 我们设计DynaTokens以尽量减小对相机条件化的影响，并有选择性地“教授”动态。

paragraphs.en: Camera-controlled video models [ 23 , 25 , 22 , 10 ] struggle with dynamics due to a combination of 3D prior [ 2 , 22 ] and the lack of dynamics in training data [ 17 ] . Methods that tackle dynamics can fall into two categories: (1) Improving existing general-purpose world models. These methods mostly focus on loosening 3D constraints in memory, such as [ 6 , 9 , 31 ] , which addresses out-of-frame dynamics. (2) Alternative formulations of 4D-aware generation models, such as BulletTime [ 29 ] which allows both camera and time control, but is limited to short and small-range camera movements. The recent Atlas model [ 26 ] enables camera-controlled dynamics generation, but requires multiple input views.
paragraphs.zh: 相机可控视频模型 [ 23 , 25 , 22 , 10 ] 由于 3D 先验 [ 2 , 22 ] 与训练数据中动态内容缺失 [ 17 ] 的共同作用，在处理动态场景时表现不佳。 解决动态问题的方法可分为两类：(1) 改进现有的通用世界模型。 这类方法主要聚焦于放宽记忆中的 3D 约束，例如 [ 6 , 9 , 31 ]，其解决了画外动态的问题。 (2) 具有替代形式的 4D 感知生成模型，例如 BulletTime [ 29 ]，它同时允许相机和时间控制，但仅限于短程、小范围的相机运动。 近期的 Atlas 模型 [ 26 ] 实现了相机可控的动态生成，但需要多个输入视图。

paragraphs.en: Test-time training methods train foundation models at test time to surpass base model capabilities in challenging tasks, such as the ARC challenge [ 1 ] , scientific discovery [ 32 ] , and long video generation [ 7 ] . Architecturally, test-time training methods either use LoRA [ 1 ] or specialized architectures like Test-time Training (TTT) layers [ 34 , 7 ] . We design DynaTokens, a new test-time training architecture for world models, to enable localized dynamic learning.

paragraphs.en: DynaTokens introduces scene-specific tokens into a pretrained camera-controlled video generation model. During training, the base model is kept frozen, and only the tokens are updated, enabling correct dynamics when exploring different camera trajectories for the scene. We motivate the design of dynamic tokens, then explain our architecture, test-time training setup, and training objective.

paragraphs.en: To achieve this, we design a lightweight add-on architecture for pretrained camera-controlled video models, enabling test-time learning of scene dynamics while preserving camera control. paragraphs.zh: 为实现这一目标，我们为预训练的相机控制视频模型设计了一种轻量级附加架构，使其能够在测试时学习场景动态，同时保留相机控制能力。 这提出了两个要求：(1) 该架构需要具备足够的表征能力，以便在保持轻量级的同时“引导”所生成视频潜变量的结构；(2) 该设计应能同时实现动态与相机控制。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DynaTokens, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a). Dynamic tokens are added to transformer blocks of a video generative model. The input video patch tokens interact with the learned dynamic tokens via cross attention. The output is added back to the model, along with the two paths of self-attention, with and without camera control (often instantiated via PRoPE [ 15 ] ). We apply this to every double stream transformer block. The projection matrix that mixes multiple heads of cross-attention is initialized at zero to ensure minimal perturbation at initialization. We keep the base model frozen, and learn only the dynamic tokens at test time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DynaTokens，如图 1 (a) 所示。 动态标记被添加到视频生成模型的 transformer 块中。 输入的视频补丁标记通过交叉注意力与学习到的动态标记进行交互。 输出被加回模型中，同时保留自注意力的两条路径，即带相机控制与不带相机控制（通常通过 PRoPE [15] 实例化）。 我们将其应用于每个双流 transformer 块。 用于混合多头交叉注意力的投影矩阵被初始化为零，以确保初始化时的扰动最小。 我们保持基础模型冻结，在测试时仅学习动态标记。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic tokens are trained at test time to enable dynamic video generation. While large-scale data curation with rich scene and camera motion is difficult, DynaTokens’ lightweight design enables learning only from a few videos ( ≈ \approx 15), which are easier to curate. We design a curation process leveraging VLMs and video interpolation, detailed in § G of the Appendix, which yields videos with dynamics. These videos might contain artifacts, and we only curate them for a few camera trajectories. Trained on these few trajectories, DynaTokens enables correct dynamics on new camera trajectories. Our setup is illustrated in Fig. 1 (b).

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the impact of DynaTokens: (1) whereas all current state-of-the-art camera-controlled video models struggle greatly with dynamics, DynaTokens can effectively enable dynamics within such models via test-time training; (2) alternative test-time training methods, such as LoRA [ 11 ] or TTT layer [ 7 ] , fail, while DynaTokens enables learning dynamics while maintaining camera control. We evaluate on a broad range of videos with dynamic changes, including motion ordering, dynamic spatial relations, text-based motion accuracy, physics, and style transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了 DynaTokens 的影响：(1) 鉴于目前所有最先进的相机控制视频模型都难以处理动态变化，DynaTokens 能够通过测试时训练有效地在此类模型中实现动态效果；(2) 其他测试时训练方法（如 LoRA [11] 或 TTT 层 [7]）均告失败，而 DynaTokens 能在保持相机控制的同时学习动态。 我们在涵盖广泛动态变化的视频上进行评估，包括运动顺序、动态空间关系、基于文本的运动准确性、物理特性以及风格变换。

sents.en: Since there are no existing dynamics-focused benchmarks for camera-controlled world models, we repurpose existing video benchmarks for dynamics-related evaluation: VBench2 [ 35 ] and WorldScore [ 8 ] .

paragraphs.en: VBench2 is a text-to-video benchmark with VLM judges. While VBench2 holistically evaluates video models, we use its dynamics-related categories, “Dynamic Spatial Relations” (DSR, e.g., “a dog is on the left of the table, then the dog runs to the front of the table”) and “Motion Order Understanding” (MOU, e.g., “a person is cooking, then they suddenly start organizing the pantry”). The original evaluation assumes a static camera, thus we make slight modifications to accommodate camera movement, such as not evaluating on frames where the main object is out-of-view due to camera movement. For camera, we calcaulte an aggregate score over rotation and translation error like WorldScore [ 8 ] , leveraging state-of-the-art camera estimation method, ViPE [ 12 ] . We evaluate on a random subset of 20 prompts across the two categories, each for 6 different camera trajectories, on a total of 120 videos for VBench. Standard errors are reported in the Appendix.

paragraphs.en: State-of-the-art camera-controlled models struggle with dynamics. paragraphs.en: LoRA, although high in representation capacity, cannot effectively disentangle dynamics from camera, and holistically “steers” the generation output, thus unable to effectively learn dynamics and yields worse camera control. We show additional analysis on LoRA and LoRA-no PRoPE in § 5 . Fine-tuning the last transformer blocks is also not sufficient for learning dynamics. TTT Layer, although preserving camera, shows distorted objects, as shown in the human example of Fig. 3 , and is unable to effectively learn dynamics. paragraphs.en: Dynamic scenes are a key challenge in camera-controlled world models. We present DynaTokens, a lightweight add-on module that can be test-time-trained to enable camera-controlled video models to learn localized dynamics for a given scene. This design is able to “selectively” teach dynamics while enabling good camera control, whereas other designs such as LoRA fail. We provide analysis on why the design of dynamic tokens can effectively disentangle local dynamics with global camera control, and show analyses with attention weights to demonstrate the localized gating effect of our design. DynaTokens, via test-time training, greatly surpasses current state-of-the-art camera-controlled video models on VBench2 dynamic categories and WorldScore, and can extend to physical dynamics and style transfer. Our analysis on the dynamic token design sheds light on the representation of dynamics and camera control for video models. DynaTokens also opens up data generation for dynamic-rich, camera-controlled videos in diverse settings, paving the way for generating dynamic, navigable worlds in the future. For more info, visit our project page https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/ .
paragraphs.zh: 动态场景是相机可控世界模型中的一个关键挑战。 我们提出 DynaTokens，这是一个轻量级的附加模块，可通过测试时训练使相机可控视频模型能够针对给定场景学习局部动态。 这一设计能够在实现良好相机控制的同时“选择性地”教授动态，而 LoRA 等其他设计则无法做到这一点。 我们分析了动态 token 的设计为何能有效解耦局部动态与全局相机控制，并通过注意力权重的分析展示我们设计的局部化门控效应。 DynaTokens 通过测试时训练，在 VBench2 动态类别和 WorldScore 上大幅超越当前最先进的相机可控视频模型，并可扩展到物理动态和风格迁移。 我们对动态 token 设计的分析为视频模型中动态与相机控制的表示提供了启示。 DynaTokens 还开启了在多样场景下生成富含动态的相机可控视频的数据生成之路，为未来生成动态、可导航的世界铺平道路。 更多信息请访问我们的项目页面 https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/ 。

paragraphs.en: The comparison with VPT and APT illustrates an important design aspect of DynaTokens. While VPT and APT were originally designed for recognition (VPT for images, and APT a more efficient version for videos), applying them to camera-controlled video generation means inserting trainable “data tokens” alongside the original data tokens. While DynaTokens also inserts new tokens, the mechanism of token interaction with the base model is very different. Unlike VPT/APT, DynaTokens does not participate in the global self attention alongside the data tokens, where camera control takes place. As shown in Fig. 1 (a) in the main paper, the camera conditioning happens via PRoPE in the self-attention. VPT/APT-style methods will interfere with camera conditioning (the added tokens are entangled in the camera and data path), thus failing to disentangle object movement from camera movement. This entanglement is exactly the source of issues with camera-controlled video models and the motivation behind DynaTokens.
paragraphs.zh: 与 VPT 和 APT 的比较说明了 DynaTokens 的一个重要设计方面。 VPT 和 APT 最初是为识别任务设计的（VPT 面向图像，APT 是面向视频的更高效版本），将它们应用于相机控制的视频生成意味着在原始数据 token 旁边插入可训练的“数据 token”。 虽然 DynaTokens 也插入新的 token，但其 token 与基础模型交互的机制非常不同。 与 VPT/APT 不同，DynaTokens 不与数据 token 一起参与全局自注意力，而相机控制正是在那里发生的。 如正文图 1（a）所示，相机条件化通过自注意力中的 PRoPE 实现。 VPT/APT 风格的方法会干扰相机条件化（所添加的 token 在相机路径和数据路径中纠缠在一起），从而无法将物体运动与相机运动解耦。 这种纠缠正是相机控制视频模型出现问题的根源，也是 DynaTokens 背后的动机所在。

paragraphs.en: We quantify DynaTokens’ attention localization by measuring the overlap between attention maps with SAM [ 21 ] masks via IoU and IoU-d1 (relaxing the IoU by counting all distance ≤ \leq 1 neighbors as correct). We note that while the attention map illustrates DynaTokens’ localization to the motion, its purpose is not to segment the exact object geometry in video frames. Additionally, DynaTokens work in latent patches which are coarse spatially and temporally (a latent patch is 16x16 pixels across 4 physical frames), and thus we expect coarse overlap rather than accurate, high-IoU boundary alignment. We compare with the attention map delta caused by LoRA, as well as the attention map from the text keyword of the moving object. We additionally show the expected IoU of a random attention mask pattern, denoted by “Chance”. As shown in Table 7 , DynaTokens has a significantly higher overlap with the SAM mask of the moving object, while LoRA and text perform similarly to random chance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过注意力图与 SAM [21] 掩码之间的 IoU 和 IoU-d1 重叠度来量化 DynaTokens 的注意力定位能力（IoU-d1 是放宽的 IoU，将所有距离 ≤ 1 的邻居也算作正确）。 我们注意到，虽然注意力图展示了 DynaTokens 对运动的定位能力，但其目的并非在视频帧中分割出物体的精确几何形状。 此外，DynaTokens 在潜空间补丁（latent patch）上工作，其空间和时间粒度都较粗（一个潜空间补丁对应 16x16 像素、跨 4 个物理帧），因此我们预期得到的是粗粒度的重叠，而非精确的、高 IoU 的边界对齐。 我们与 LoRA 引起的注意力图变化，以及来自运动物体文本关键词的注意力图进行比较。 我们还展示了随机注意力掩码模式的预期 IoU，记为“Chance”（随机水平）。 如表 7 所示，DynaTokens 与运动物体的 SAM 掩码重叠度显著更高，而 LoRA 和文本方法的表现与随机水平相近。

paragraphs.en: We perform additional ablations on a subset of evaluation scenes to evaluate the robustness of DynaTokens to the quantity and quality of training trajectories. In Table 8 , we perform an additional study by training on 3/6/12 trajectories on a subset of 30 evaluation videos. Notably, even when training on as few as 3 trajectories, DynaTokens shows a considerable advantage on MOU (0.50 vs. 0.35 for the best baseline, LiveWorld), which is a positive result. Other metrics (DSR, MOU, MA) beat baselines even at 6 trajectories. This shows that DynaTokens is effective even with a small number of training trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在部分评估场景上进行了额外的消融实验，以评估 DynaTokens 对训练轨迹数量和质量的鲁棒性。 在表 8 中，我们在 30 个评估视频的子集上分别使用 3/6/12 条轨迹进行训练，开展了一项额外的研究。 值得注意的是，即使仅用 3 条轨迹进行训练，DynaTokens 在 MOU 上仍展现出显著优势（0.50 对比最佳基线 LiveWorld 的 0.35），这是一个积极的结果。 其他指标（DSR、MOU、MA）在使用 6 条轨迹训练时也超过了各基线。 这表明即使训练轨迹数量很少，DynaTokens 依然是有效的。

paragraphs.en: For VBench2 evaluation, we use the “Dynamic Spatial Relations” and “Motion Order Understanding” categories. We use VBench’s original VLM evaluation framework with minor modifications to accommodate camera movement, since the original framework is designed for static camera. For example, VBench2 determines object spatial relation by the first and last frame. Since camera-controlled models might occasionally turn the camera away from the main object ( e.g., camera turns left while object moves right and out of frame), we add an “object presence” detection and only apply this check when the main object is present in the last frame. We also remove the questions solely based on the first frame, since all methods we test take the same first frame as input. We use Gemini 2.5 Flash instead of Llava for better spatial relation understanding. To avoid Gemini bias, we additionally use GPT-5 for verification, which yields very similar results: the mean difference is 0.025, which is less than 10% of the observed advantage of DynaTokens over the best baseline (Lingbot) on dynamic spatial relations. For methods that generate highly distorted or unrecognizable subjects, we add “recognizable and not distorted” to the evaluation prompt. We use a state-of-the-art camera estimation method, ViPE [ 12 ] to estimate camera, and calculate camera score based on a geometric mean of rotation and translation errors, where rotation error is denoted by geodesic distance, similar to WorldScore [ 8 ] . Since the translation is dependent on the unit for each model, we apply scaling to correct for the unit conversion.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 VBench2 评估，我们使用「动态空间关系」和「运动顺序理解」两个类别。 我们使用 VBench 原有的 VLM 评估框架，并做了少量修改以适配摄像机运动，因为原框架是为静止摄像机设计的。 例如，VBench2 通过第一帧和最后一帧来判断物体的空间关系。 由于相机控制模型可能偶尔将相机转离主要物体（例如，相机向左转动而物体向右移动并移出画面），我们增加了「物体存在」检测，仅在最后一帧中出现主要物体时才应用该检查。 我们还删除了仅基于第一帧的问题，因为我们测试的所有方法都使用相同的第一帧作为输入。 我们使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 而非 Llava，以获得更好的空间关系理解能力。 为避免 Gemini 的偏差，我们额外使用 GPT-5 进行验证，结果非常相似：平均差异为 0.025，小于 DynaTokens 相对于最佳基线（Lingbot）在动态空间关系上所观察到优势的 10%。 对于生成主体高度失真或无法辨认的方法，我们在评估提示中加入了「可辨认且无失真」。 我们使用最先进的相机估计方法 ViPE [ 12 ] 来估计相机，并基于旋转误差和平移误差的几何平均值计算相机分数，其中旋转误差用测地距离表示，类似于 WorldScore [ 8 ]。 由于平移依赖于每个模型的单位，我们应用缩放来校正单位转换。

sents.en: Since camera-controlled models might occasionally turn the camera away from the main object ( e.g., camera turns left while object moves right and out of frame), we add an “object presence” detection and only apply this check when the main object is present in the last frame.
sents.zh: 由于相机控制模型可能偶尔将相机转离主要物体（例如，相机向左转动而物体向右移动并移出画面），我们增加了「物体存在」检测，仅在最后一帧中出现主要物体时才应用该检查。

sents.en: We also remove the questions solely based on the first frame, since all methods we test take the same first frame as input.
sents.zh: 我们还删除了仅基于第一帧的问题，因为我们测试的所有方法都使用相同的第一帧作为输入。

sents.en: We use Gemini 2.5 Flash instead of Llava for better spatial relation understanding.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 而非 Llava，以获得更好的空间关系理解能力。

sents.en: To avoid Gemini bias, we additionally use GPT-5 for verification, which yields very similar results: the mean difference is 0.025, which is less than 10% of the observed advantage of DynaTokens over the best baseline (Lingbot) on dynamic spatial relations.
sents.zh: 为避免 Gemini 的偏差，我们额外使用 GPT-5 进行验证，结果非常相似：平均差异为 0.025，小于 DynaTokens 相对于最佳基线（Lingbot）在动态空间关系上所观察到优势的 10%。

sents.en: For methods that generate highly distorted or unrecognizable subjects, we add “recognizable and not distorted” to the evaluation prompt.
sents.zh: 对于生成主体高度失真或无法辨认的方法，我们在评估提示中加入了「可辨认且无失真」。

sents.en: We use a state-of-the-art camera estimation method, ViPE [ 12 ] to estimate camera, and calculate camera score based on a geometric mean of rotation and translation errors, where rotation error is denoted by geodesic distance, similar to WorldScore [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: 我们使用最先进的相机估计方法 ViPE [ 12 ] 来估计相机，并基于旋转误差和平移误差的几何平均值计算相机分数，其中旋转误差用测地距离表示，类似于 WorldScore [ 8 ]。

sents.en: Since the translation is dependent on the unit for each model, we apply scaling to correct for the unit conversion.
sents.zh: 由于平移依赖于每个模型的单位，我们应用缩放来校正单位转换。

paragraphs.en: The WorldScore benchmark’s dynamic evaluation is largely based on optical flow, and assumes a static camera (thus low background flow). To adapt it to the moving camera setting, we adapt the Motion Accuracy and Camera Control metrics. Two other metrics, Motion Magnitude and Motion Smoothness, are both dominated by camera-induced flow rather than scene dynamics and are thus not suitable for this task. Motion Accuracy uses SEA-RAFT [ 28 ] dense flow and SAM2 [ 20 ] object masks to score whether the prompted subject moves more than its surroundings; we (i) set the object-region flow to zero when SAM2 fails to localize the subject, so lost or distorted subjects are penalized rather than collapsing into a whole-frame statistic, and (ii) replace the background maximum with the background median , since under camera motion the background flow distribution is heavy-tailed and its maximum is unstable. Camera Control recovers the trajectory via DROID-SLAM [ 27 ] and scores the clipped geometric mean of rotation geodesic error and scale-aligned translation ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error, with C ∗ = arg ⁡ min C ⁡ ‖ t gt − C ​ t pred ‖ 2 C^{*}=\arg\min_{C}\|t_{\text{gt}}-C\,t_{\text{pred}}\|_{2} ; we constrain C ∈ [ c min , c max ] C\in[c_{\min},c_{\max}] to avoid the loophole where under-translating prediction is rescaled to match the ground-truth magnitude.
paragraphs.zh: WorldScore 基准的动态评估主要基于光流，并假设相机静止（因此背景光流较低）。 为了将其适配到运动相机的场景，我们改进了运动准确性和相机控制这两项指标。 另外两项指标，运动幅度和运动平滑度，都主要由相机引起的光流而非场景动态主导，因此不适用于此任务。 运动准确性使用 SEA-RAFT [ 28 ] 的稠密光流和 SAM2 [ 20 ] 的物体掩码来评分提示主体是否比其周围环境移动得更多；我们 (i) 在 SAM2 未能定位主体时将物体区域的光流置零，使丢失或畸变的主体受到惩罚，而不是塌缩为整帧统计量，并且 (ii) 将背景最大值替换为背景中位数，因为在相机运动下背景光流分布呈重尾特性，其最大值不稳定。 相机控制通过 DROID-SLAM [ 27 ] 恢复轨迹，并对旋转测地误差与尺度对齐平移 ℓ 2 \ell_{2} 误差的截断几何平均值进行评分，其中 C ∗ = arg ⁡ min C ⁡ ‖ t gt − C ​ t pred ‖ 2 C^{*}=\arg\min_{C}\|t_{\text{gt}}-C\,t_{\text{pred}}\|_{2} ；我们将 C ∈ [ c min , c max ] C\in[c_{\min},c_{\max}] 加以约束，以避免平移不足的预测被重新缩放以匹配真实幅值的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: It is important to note that, although our curated videos contain both scene and camera motion, stitching can introduce artifacts in background appearance and motion continuity. For example, the scene layout or object appearance may change across frames, and temporal discontinuities may arise. Qualitative examples can be found in Fig. 6 . However, since the base model remains frozen and dynamic tokens contribute only through localized, additive cross-attention, this imperfect supervision can teach scene dynamics without corrupting the pretrained prior. Model inference calls take 16 minutes on 8 A100 GPUs (with shared prefix skipping), and API call for Gemini and Kling cost $1.52 for all training trajectories. Our DynaTokens design can train on few trajectories, enabling camera-controlled models to produce correct dynamics for new, unseen camera trajectories.

paragraphs.en: We train K = 16 K=16 dynamic tokens of dimension m = 64 m=64 in our experiments, for videos ranging from 61 to 93 frames. paragraphs.en: DynaTokens is a lightweight module added to pretrained video models. Dynamic tokens enable dynamics by effectively disentangling it from camera control. However, if the base model is poor at certain dynamics, learning with dynamic tokens should not expect to fully fix these issues, such as complex physics.
paragraphs.zh: DynaTokens 是一个添加到预训练视频模型中的轻量级模块。 动态令牌通过有效地将动态与相机控制解耦来实现动态效果。 然而，如果基础模型在某些动态方面表现不佳，使用动态令牌进行学习不应期望完全解决这些问题，例如复杂物理。

paragraphs.en: We also provide more analysis on why LoRA-No PRoPE fails. While it does not significantly reduce the number of free parameters compared to normal LoRA, this might be causing great discrepancy between the PRoPE vs. non-PRoPE stream (which was designed to be symmetric in the original architecture), thus hindering learning. This shows that LoRA, with its global entanglement across spatial patches, struggles to only learn dynamics without affecting camera control. Dynamic tokens, on the other hand, minimizes the effect on PRoPE by being local - unaffected patches’ keys and values stay mostly stable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还对 LoRA-No PRoPE 失效的原因提供了更多分析。 虽然与普通 LoRA 相比，它并没有显著减少自由参数的数量，但这可能导致 PRoPE 流与非 PRoPE 流之间产生巨大差异（在原始架构中这两者本被设计为对称的），从而阻碍了学习。 这表明 LoRA 由于其在空间图块之间的全局纠缠，难以只学习动态而不影响相机控制。 另一方面，动态 token 通过局部化的方式将对 PRoPE 的影响降到最低——未受影响的图块的键和值基本保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: We improve generative video models. We acknowledge that generative models can be used in ways that raise ethical concerns, including the creation of misleading synthetic media, amplification of societal biases present in training data, and potential misuse for surveillance or harmful automation. Our work is intended solely for scientific research purposes and focuses on advancing the understanding and capability of generative modeling systems. We do not release systems or artifacts designed for deceptive or malicious use, and we encourage responsible deployment practices, including transparency about generated content, careful dataset curation, and evaluation for fairness and safety.
